decisions.why: Despite the division name, all four examples are Romachair wheelchairs, matching "Wheelchairs and specialist seating".
AED cabinets and a Powerheart G5 defibrillator directly match "Defibrillator / AED devices & accessories".
Cutan lotion/foam hand wash cartridges are washroom hand-hygiene consumables rather than a clinical skin-prep or PPE product.
Lubricating jelly sachets and condoms match "Sexual health & contraception".
One-way and two-way spirometry mouthpieces match "Diagnostics & spirometry".
Examples show both handheld/fingertip pulse oximeter devices (non-specialist monitoring) and a dedicated SpO2 sensor probe.
Healthcare tunics are clinical workwear, matching "Scrubs & clinical workwear".
A toilet aid and raised toilet seats (Invamed Super RTS) match "Bathing and toileting aids".
Bath boards and a bath seat directly match "Bathing and toileting aids".
Two seca spot-check vital signs monitors anchor this division to non-specialist patient monitoring devices.
Sunflower NOMAD medicine cabinets are pharmacy dispensing/cassette storage equipment, matching "Pharmacy services & equipment".
Clinical disinfectant and sanitising wipes (Uniwipe, Nilaqua, Clinell) match "Antimicrobial wipes & cleansing".
A urine specimen container is a laboratory consumable while the CardioChek cholesterol/glucose test strips are point-of-care testing products.
The "Alertamat" variants are named by nurse-call system compatibility (Quantec, Medicare MTM6001nc), indicating a sensor/alarm accessory wired into telecare call systems rather than furniture.
Silicone 2-way Foley catheter exchange kits match "Indwelling (Foley) catheters".
Strapping tape, washproof plasters and corn plasters match "First Aid".
Gel holders and soap/foam dispensers are washroom hygiene hardware, matching "Washroom, paper hygiene & waste management".
Examples are socket mop heads for cleaning, matching cleaning tools & equipment.
